data.standardized_narrative: In 2018, Syndicate 6111 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 6.0 million, representing a 3.01% increase relative to its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by natural catastrophe events in the second half of 2017, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and California Wildfires, impacting the 2016 and 2017 years of account. The strengthening was wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2016 year of account and a prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 17 does not show any prior year development for years up to 2016, which contradicts the explicit GBP 6.0m strengthening stated in Note 5. The syndicate operates on a funds withheld basis and closes years of account via reinsurance to close, which may affect how development is presented in the triangle after closure. The figure from Note 5 is used as the primary source for prior year development.
